introduction: 211 NH offers non-emergency referrals around the clock, every day of the year. Call when you need help finding local food, housing, utility or other community services.
description: 211 NH offers non-emergency referrals around the clock, every day of the year. Call when you need help finding local food, housing, utility or other community services.

sections.who: Resource information is available without a public-benefit approval. Providers receiving referrals apply their own eligibility and service-area rules.
sections.get: A specialist identifies relevant organizations, and the online directory offers another search route. A referral does not reserve funding or approve an application.

sections.apply:
1. Call or search

    Dial 211 or 866-444-4211, or visit 211 NH.

  2. Explain the need

    Describe the situation and whether an urgent notice or lack of shelter is involved.

  3. Contact the provider

    Ask the referred organization about current intake and what it needs to assess your request.
sections.after: Ask for another option if the first referral is unavailable. Use the emergency contact appropriate to an immediate safety emergency rather than treating a resource request as emergency dispatch.
sections.sources: Checked October 1, 2026 using 211 NH contact and service information. USA Assistance background guide. Program staff determine eligibility and available assistance.

faqs: The provider advertises 24-hour access, 365 days a year.

provenance.scope: Published eligibility, service purpose and application pathway; no unverified financial limits or deadlines included.
